prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with high carbohydrate intake for sustained energy and recovery

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all three meals plus pre/post-training nutrition for a single day
Total daily carbohydrates are approximately 60% of total calories to support endurance training
Includes adequate protein (1.2-1.6g per kg body weight) for muscle recovery
Provides practical, compact meal suggestions with estimated portions
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with an endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high carbohydrate intake and sustained energy throughout training and recovery periods

prompt_inputs.goal: Build muscle mass and maximize strength performance for weightlifting competition

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains 4-5 meals distributed throughout the day with high protein content (minimum 30g per meal)
Total daily calories and macronutrient breakdown support muscle building for a 90kg strength athlete
Meals are compact and practical, optimized for caloric density and nutrient timing around training
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) needing high protein distribution and caloric density to support muscle building and performance

prompt_inputs.goal: Optimize energy and recovery for soccer match performance

solution_criteria: Includes 3-4 meals/snacks timed around soccer practice schedule (assume afternoon 2-hour session)
Provides balanced macronutrients suitable for endurance athlete
All meals comply with vegan and unprocessed food restrictions
Meal plan is concise (1 day only) and actionable
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific constraint scenario (vegan soccer player) combining dietary restrictions with athletic performance requirements and meal timing around practice schedules
